name: @fz/game-ui
description: The Angular chrome the games share and the site doesn't: the game bar, its overflow and choice menus and the overflow menu's shared items, its Pause and Sound, the viewport and breakpoints they change shape at, the page frame, the settings drawer and the version it shows, the global stylesheet and the Sass toolkit a game's stylesheets load, How to play and its catalog lists, the stopwatch, the source a game's seeds are drawn from, the run's lifecycle a game's service extends, Report a bug, which opens an issue filled in with the game's state and offers a picture of the page, and the debug menu a development build offers, and a production one at ?debug.

scripts.typecheck: ngc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && tsc7 -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc7 -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc7 -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: eslint src eslint.config.js stylelint.config.js vitest.config.ts && yarn lint:styles
